record.name: Help Scout
record.one_liner: Help Scout provides Mailbox, Chat, and Docs APIs, webhooks, and sidebar apps for automating customer support workflows.

auth.notes: Authentication is based on API Keys passed via HTTP Basic Authentication in the username field with a dummy password.

access.notes: Developers can create apps and configure webhooks or generate API keys directly through the Help Scout user interface and developer documentation.

api_surface.notes: Help Scout offers Mailbox API 2.0, Chat API, Docs API, Webhooks, and JavaScript SDKs/UI Kits for building custom sidebar apps.

mcp.notes: No Model Context Protocol integrations or endpoints are mentioned in the provided documentation.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve developer tools and well-documented API keys/webhooks make building integrations straightforward.

evidence.claim: Help Scout provides Apps, Beacon, Inbox API, Chat API, Docs API, and Webhooks for developers.
Authentication for the Mailbox API is based on API Keys passed via HTTP Basic Authentication.
Webhooks can be configured through the Help Scout user interface under Workspace > Apps.
Help Scout offers a JavaScript SDK and React UI Kit for building sidebar extensions.
